title: A clearer view of work across projects
question: All three approaches include attention, active work and recent changes. Choose the overall layout; the existing Forge identity stays.

options.label: Attention desk
options.thesis: A shared desk for decisions, current work and recent changes across projects.
options.viewport: Project switcher on the left; a spacious attention queue in the centre; active work and a compact event timeline beside it.
options.risk: Needs clear reasons for attention so ordinary activity does not become an alarm.

options.label: Connected timeline
options.thesis: See how people, agents and source changes led to the current state.
options.viewport: A wide dated event spine groups changes by project; selecting an event opens its context and proposed source alongside.
options.risk: A busy project can dominate unless project and event filters are used.

options.label: Project landscape
options.thesis: Compare the state of every project without opening each one.
options.viewport: Projects are horizontal bands with aligned attention, active work and latest change columns; a selected item opens a detail workspace.
options.risk: Very large portfolios need filtering; each row must stay concise.
